parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Describe the main teachings of Qur’an 13.3.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Explain how the Prophet (pbuh) showed Muslims how to be mindful of their duties towards
God. You must refer to Hadith 73 and any other Hadith you have studied in your answer.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
To what extent can observing signs guide Muslims? Discuss with reference to different points
of view. 
EITHER

text: Read the following text passages, then answer the questions which follow.
And it is He who spread out the earth, and set thereon mountains standing firm and (flowing)
rivers: and fruit of every kind He made in pairs, two and two: He draweth the night as a veil o’er
the Day. Behold, verily in these things there are signs for those who consider!
